results.label: this tree ships the zone-method vocabulary and the consolidation walk (src/bots/smc.js) (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the parent tree IS the committed release this milestone is built on: it carries the M56 plan gate and the earlier review modules, and no zone-method vocabulary
the fixture is a real workspace on the parent’s own boot: a user, an account and two closed trades, with the parent’s whole schema created around them
the parent’s own settings route accepts the new key with 200 and stores a row WITHOUT it — the shape every existing trader’s row is in
and the row it wrote really is a settings row the app serves: the other body field lands (min_rr 1.5), so the drop is the KEY and not the write
the parent’s engine carries no zone-method key on a zone and ignores the option entirely: `zoneMethod: 'range'` returns byte-identical boxes
the delivered tree creates exactly the parent’s schema: every table, index and trigger is byte-identical DDL, and no object anywhere is named after the key
the parent’s own row is read un-migrated: the stored settings the delivered tree sees are the parent’s bytes, with no `zone_method` added at open time
with that row a real `/bots/analyse` reports the PIVOT method and says WHERE it came from: nobody chose (`default`) and nothing was requested (`requested: null`)
so the row the parent wrote is read exactly as the parent read it: not one zone carries the range geometry
and the zones now carry the geometry that was used (`zone_method`) and the walk behind it (`base`) — the naming the parent had nowhere to put
choosing the range method through the delivered route writes ONE key into the parent’s row — `zone_method` — and drops nothing

and the tables a read DOES touch are exactly the ones the released build touched on the same two reads — this milestone adds no write of its own
the vocabulary and the closed source list travel with the module itself: `pivot`/`range`, and `request`/`settings`/`unspecified`/`default`
a committed parent opening the file AFTER a choice was made has never heard of the key: it round-trips it in its own echo (it spreads what it found) and reads none of it
